# Texture code lookup

Source: [TX Reference Sheet](../archive/9562.md); page edited 2026-08-27.

Read [behavior and limitations](../articles/9562.md#wiki-9562) before using these values.

Payload follows tx inside engine texture markup. Literal Custom String input is normally sanitized; see the separate dated TX/FG behavior notes before assuming markup works.

The source is explicitly incomplete and patch-sensitive; TX Browser code 8B9H1 supplied its observations.

Non-16-digit source identifiers are preserved and flagged, not silently padded. Remote screenshots are omitted; no image recognition/visual matching is promised.
